heuristics.statement: Generic birthday attack on 11-round Poseidon (r=3 partial rounds) over the Pallas field. For 256-bit output, the birthday bound requires approximately 2^128 evaluations to find a collision with high probability.
heuristics.scope: Time estimate is the theoretical birthday bound. No algebraic structure is exploited.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard birthday paradox: for n-bit output, collision requires O(2^(n/2)) = O(2^128) evaluations.
heuristics.limitations: This is the generic attack complexity. Algebraic techniques may potentially improve upon this, but such improvements require sophisticated polynomial arithmetic and root-finding over finite fields, which are not implemented or validated in this submission.
